name: DEV — Outreach Drafting Agent — Confirm Sent

parameters.responseBody:
Confirm your outreach

You are about to mark this lead as touched for today.

This action will update Last Touch, Touch Count, and Draft Status on the Leads board.

jsonBody.query: query($itemId: String!) { items(ids: [$itemId]) { id column_values(ids: ["numeric_mm5hz9v6","date_mm5h5ntw","color_mm5qmmt"]) { id text value } } }

parameters.jsCode: const TOUCH_COUNT_COL='numeric_mm5hz9v6';const LAST_TOUCH_COL='date_mm5h5ntw';const STATUS_COL='color_mm5qmmt';function parseCount(raw){if(raw===undefined||raw===null)return null;const n=parseInt(String(raw).replace(/"/g,'').trim(),10);return isNaN(n)?null:n;}function findInColumnValues(obj,colId){const cvs=(obj&&obj.column_values)||[];for(const cv of cvs){if(!cv||cv.id!==colId)continue;if(colId===TOUCH_COUNT_COL)return parseCount(cv.text!==undefined?cv.text:cv.value);return cv.text||cv.value||'';}return null;}const data=$input.first().json.data||{};const items=data.items||[];if(!items.length)return[{json:{ok:false,status:404,error:'Item not found'}}];const item=items[0];let currentTouch=findInColumnValues(item,TOUCH_COUNT_COL);if(currentTouch===null)return[{json:{ok:false,status:503,error:'Touch Count unreadable - cannot proceed safely'}}];const today=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'America/Chicago',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).format(new Date());return[{json:{ok:true,itemId:item.id,currentTouch,newTouchCount:currentTouch+1,today,currentStatus:findInColumnValues(item,STATUS_COL)||'Unknown',currentLastTouch:findInColumnValues(item,LAST_TOUCH_COL)||''}}];

jsonBody.query: mutation($itemId: String!, $today: Date!, $count: Float!) { change_column_value(item_id: $itemId, column_id: "date_mm5h5ntw", value: $today) { id column_values { id text } } change_column_value(item_id: $itemId, column_id: "numeric_mm5hz9v6", value: $count) { id column_values { id text } } change_column_value(item_id: $itemId, column_id: "color_mm5qmmt", value: "Sent") { id column_values { id text } } }

parameters.responseBody:
Marked as touched today

Board updated — Last Touch, Touch Count, and Draft Status are current.

Item ID: {{ $json.itemId }}
